hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null || echo ''); if [[ "$FILE" == *.py ]] && command -v uv &>/dev/null && [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then echo "[Harness] Python 파일 변경 감지 → ruff check 중..."; uv run ruff check "$FILE" 2>&1 | tail -20; fi

if [ -f "pyproject.toml" ] && command -v uv &>/dev/null && grep -q 'tool.uv.workspace' pyproject.toml 2>/dev/null; then echo "[Harness] 작업 완료 → uv workspace ruff + mypy 실행 중..."; uv run ruff check . 2>&1 | tail -15; uv run mypy services packages --no-error-summary 2>&1 | tail -15; fi
